landing.invite_desc: The family portal is accessed through an invitation sent by your parish. If you haven't received one yet, speak with your catechist or parish coordinator.
landing.staff_hint: Are you a coordinator or catechist?

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Access your family dashboard.
login.token_hint: When you sign in or create an account, you can accept the invitation you received.

signup.title: Create Account
signup.requires_invite: Family portal registration requires an invitation from your parish. Use the link you received by email.
signup.email_hint: Use the same email as the invitation ({{email}}).
signup.expired_desc: This invitation has expired. Ask your coordinator for a new one.
signup.invalid_desc: Invalid invitation token. Check the link.

invite.title: You've been invited!
invite.status_pending_hint: Next step: sign in with the invite email (or create an account) and tap Accept invitation.
invite.what_to_do_logged_in: Check that the signed-in account uses the invite email, then accept below.
invite.what_to_do_logged_out: 1) Sign in or create an account with the invite email. 2) Return to this page. 3) Tap Accept invitation.
invite.accept_error: Could not accept the invitation. Try again or ask your parish for a new link.
invite.login_to_accept: To accept, sign in or create an account with the invite email.
invite.login_to_accept_staff: To accept the pastoral team invitation, sign in or create an account.
invite.accepted_desc: You are now part of {{parish}} as {{role}}.
invite.not_found_desc: We could not find this invitation. Check the link or code. If it still fails, ask your catechist or coordinator for a new invite.
invite.expired_desc_accept: This invitation has expired. Ask your catechist or parish coordinator for a new one — the old link no longer works.
invite.wrong_email_desc: You signed in with another account. Sign out and sign in (or create an account) with the same email that received the invite.
invite.already_used_desc: This invitation was already accepted. If you already have access, sign in to the family portal. If not, ask your parish for a new invite.
invite.generic_error_desc: Try again in a moment. If it keeps failing, ask your catechist or coordinator for a new link.
invite.ask_new_invite: Ask your parish for a new invite

invite_code.title: Enter invite code
invite_code.subtitle: Paste the code you received by email or WhatsApp from your parish.
invite_code.label: Invite code
invite_code.empty_error: Enter the invite code to continue.
invite_code.help_expired: If the invite expired, ask your parish for a new one — old codes do not work.
invite_code.help_where: The code is usually the part after /convite/ in the email link.

portal_invites.title: Family Portal Invites
portal_invites.subtitle: Invite guardians and catechumens to follow meetings, attendance and documents in the family portal — without pastoral admin access.
portal_invites.how_1: You send an invite with email and role (guardian or catechumen).
portal_invites.how_2: They open the link (email or WhatsApp) on the family portal.
portal_invites.how_3: They sign up or log in with the same email and accept the invite.
portal_invites.how_4: They only see their own family / their own profile.
portal_invites.how_note: WhatsApp is only for sharing the link. Login is always by email. Family users never see roll call, class admin or billing.
portal_invites.link_ready: Link ready to copy or share on WhatsApp
portal_invites.whatsapp_text: Hi! Here is your invite to the catechesis Family Portal: {{url}}
portal_invites.empty_desc: When you invite a guardian or catechumen, status appears here to resend or copy the link.
portal_invites.status_expired_hint: Expired — resend to generate a new link.
portal_invites.status_pending_hint: Waiting for the person to open the link and accept in the family portal.
portal_invites.tip_context: Tip: you can also invite from the family or catechumen page. This hub lists all portal invites.
portal_invites.need_parish_desc: Choose the parish workspace to manage family portal invites.
portal_invites.banner_title: Family Portal invites in one place
portal_invites.banner_desc: Invite guardians and catechumens, track pending invites, copy the link or share on WhatsApp.
portal_invites.context_guardian: Invite this guardian to the portal
